title: Čech cochains of a map of presheaves of sets
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $f:P\to Q$ a map of presheaves of sets. Let $F$ be an abelian presheaf. Form $N_n(f)=P\times_Q\cdots\times_Q P$ with $n+1$ factors in the presheaf category. Apply the free abelian group functor objectwise to $N_\bullet(f)$, then apply $\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{PAb}(\mathcal C)}(-,F)$. The resulting cosimplicial abelian group defines a cochain complex $\check C^n(f,F)=\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf Z[N_n(f)],F)$, whose differential is the alternating sum of precomposition by the face maps deleting one factor. This is a real construction, without any assumptions on fibre products in $\mathcal C$; it is the presheaf-nerve variant of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex].
